name: Building Your First Setlist
instructions: Choose 2-3 songs you can play reasonably well and consider them your first "setlist" -- songs you could play for someone else.
Practice transitioning from one song directly into the next without a long pause.
Play your setlist for someone (even just once) -- performing, even informally, is a different skill from practicing alone.
Watch today's video again for more easy song ideas to add to your list.
